# DeskShare

> DeskShare is a free, open source app for remote computer help: you show your screen to someone you trust, and they connect in the browser or in the app.

- What it is: screen sharing and remote help over WebRTC with low latency and end-to-end encrypted media (DTLS/SRTP), directly or through a TURN relay.
- Who it is for: people who need help with their computer from someone they trust, and the people who help them. An MSI package is available for companies.
- How it works: download DeskShare, choose "I need help" and tell your helper your number and code. The helper enters them in the browser or app and sees your screen.
- Safety: the code changes every 60 seconds. You approve mouse and keyboard control for every connection; without an answer the request is denied after 30 seconds. You can stop sharing at any time.
- Price: free.
- Platforms: Windows (Setup .exe, Portable .zip, MSI), macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel .pkg), Linux (AppImage, beta). The helper can also connect from a web browser.
- Operator: Martin Zahálka, Boskovice, Czech Republic, company ID (IČO) 07783809.
- Contact: martin@zcloud.cz
- Source code: https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare
- Czech version (main): https://deskshare.zcloud.cz/llms.txt

## Pages

- [DeskShare (English)](https://deskshare.zcloud.cz/en/): home page in English, three-step guide, safety tips and downloads.
- [DeskShare (Czech)](https://deskshare.zcloud.cz/): home page in Czech.
- [Privacy](https://deskshare.zcloud.cz/en/privacy/): how DeskShare processes personal data (website, app, signaling server and TURN relay).
- [Connect in your browser](https://app.deskshare.zcloud.cz/webclient/index.html?lang=en): web viewer for the helper, who enters the other person's number and code.

## Downloads

- [Windows Setup .exe](https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare/releases/latest/download/DeskShare-win-Setup.exe): Windows installer.
- [Windows Portable .zip](https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare/releases/latest/download/DeskShare-win-Portable.zip): portable version, no installation.
- [MSI for companies](https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare/releases/latest/download/DeskShare-x64.msi): package for company deployment.
- [macOS Apple Silicon .pkg](https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare/releases/latest/download/DeskShare-osx-Setup.pkg): installer for Apple Silicon Macs.
- [macOS Intel .pkg](https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare/releases/latest/download/DeskShare-osx-x64-Setup.pkg): installer for Intel Macs.
- [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/zcloudcz/DeskShare/releases/latest/download/DeskShare.AppImage): Linux version (beta).
